subject: QBR: field briefs & forecast consolidation — owner inputs requested
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Tara Patel <tara@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2027-02-07T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: QBR: field briefs & forecast consolidation — owner inputs requested

Team / Tara —

As we prepare the QBR readout for next Tuesday, I want to consolidate field-level pipeline notes and get owner-level confirmation for a clean forecast. High level asks:  (1) each AE to update the attached QBR_Field_Briefs.xlsx with ARR, close probability, key risks, and next milestone; (2) provide a single-line confidence call (Commit/Upside/Weaker) for the deal; (3) flag any highlight accounts for a short 3-slide appendix in the deck.

Specifically for Acme (Tara, cc'd): we want to summarize the integration milestone and procurement timing in the consolidated forecast — if procurement has a target PO week, please share.

Deadlines: please update the spreadsheet and add comments by EOD Monday (2027-02-08 17:00 PT). I pulled the latest opportunity notes into the file and sketched an initial consolidation tab. The QBR deck link (draft) is also attached for context: deck-qbr-draft-v3.pptx.

Attachments: QBR_Field_Briefs.xlsx (spreadsheet), deck-qbr-draft-v3.pptx (pptx), Acme_MOP_v2.pdf (procurement doc)

Next steps: once owners hit the spreadsheet I'll run a reconciliation pass and publish the forecast summary to the exec deck. If any deal is at risk of slipping, flag it in the "Risk" column and add a short mitigation plan.

Thanks —
Avery
Avery Johnson
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai
--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tara Patel <tara@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2027-02-07T11:32:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR: field briefs & forecast consolidation — owner inputs requested

Avery —

Thanks, on it. I updated rows for Acme and two other mid-market deals:
- Acme Corp (RDW-D-2027-ACME-1193): moved to Commit. Procurement indicated a verbal PO target for week of 2027-02-21; I left the comment with the sourcing contact in the spreadsheet.
- Helios Labs: probability reduced (we lost an internal champion) — marked as Upside with mitigation.
- Nimbus Retail: still green, close date unchanged — added product milestone (private deploy checklist).

Comments: I put short notes in the "Risks" column and attached a brief MOP for Acme (Acme_MOP_v2.pdf). For the appendix, recommend we include Acme as the primary case study (integration timeline and procurement path useful for peers).

Question for Vivek/Karthik: do you want me to normalize ARR currency to USD on the consolidation tab or leave original currency and provide a conversion column? I can do the conversion if helpful.

Attachment: Acme_MOP_v2.pdf

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
--

From: Tara Patel <tara@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2027-02-08T09:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR: field briefs & forecast consolidation — owner inputs requested

Hi Marissa / Avery —

Thanks for the note and for pulling the MOP together. Procurement confirms they expect to circulate an internal approval to the finance team the week of 2/21 and our preferred PO week would be 2/28. I'll ask them to put that date range in writing by Monday.

Two asks from our side for the QBR appendix: 1) could you include a short timeline graphic for the integration milestones (we can share our internal milestone doc); 2) include SLA/uptime commitments and key data retention controls in the appendix (we will need those for our audit).

We'll update procurement@acme.com once we have the written confirmation.

Best,
Tara Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships, Acme Corp
tara@acme.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tara Patel <tara@acme.com>
Date: 2027-02-09T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR: field briefs & forecast consolidation — owner inputs requested

Thanks all — quick reconciliation update before I fold into the deck:

Summary changes I made in the consolidation tab:
- Normalized all ARR to USD (conversion column added) — used FX snapshot as of 2027-02-01.
- Merged duplicate rows for Acme (internal CRM had two opp ids linked; I consolidated under RDW-D-2027-ACME-1193).
- Commit ARR moved to the exec forecast: $1.2M (Acme portion $750k).
- Flagged Helios as "Upside" (impact -$210k) and Nimbus as Commit ($120k).

Outstanding items (need before final deck):
1) Tara/procurement: written confirmation for target PO week (2/28 preferred) — please send to procurement@acme.com and cc the thread.
2) Marissa: please add one-line mitigation plans for Helios and any other Upside deals (comment in the spreadsheet).
3) Laura/Karthik: if there are any cross-functional risks (security/compliance notes for appendix), add them under the "Appendix Notes" column; we need this by EOD Monday so the slides can be finalized.

I will cut the final summary slide and append the 3-account appendix once the items above are complete. Draft exec deck is at the Drive link in the sheet.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
